mapper.select: SELECT u.name AS customerName, si.item_name AS productName, o.status AS status, o.created_at AS orderDate FROM `cors`.`orders` o JOIN `cors`.`order_items` oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON oi.item_id = si.id LEFT JOIN `cors`.`users` u ON o.user_email = u.email WHERE oi.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT si.item_name AS productName, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) AS totalSales, (SELECT `img`.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` AS `img` WHERE `img`.`product_id` = `si`.`id` ORDER BY `img`.`id` ASC LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`order_items` oi JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON oi.item_id = si.id JOIN `cors`.`orders` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE oi.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY si.id, si.item_name ORDER BY totalSales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
